HB 475, State ID Cards for High School Students. Budd is named among the primary sponsors. It lets residents aged 16 and up get a state special identification card and sets up a pilot to issue the cards to public high school students in four counties. It does not mention voting. It was referred to committee.
HB 780, State ID Cards for High School Students (2023 version). Budd is listed first among the primary sponsors. It was referred to committee and later re-referred. It does not mention voting.
